notes:
I couldn't write any notes on Jeremiah 49. My first attempt to fetch the sources was refused because I had used up my research tool calls for this turn. None of the pages loaded: Enduring Word's Jeremiah 49 commentary, or Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read nothing, any verse notes I wrote now would break that rule, so I've left them out.

If you ask again in a new message, my research tools should be available. I'd work in this order:
1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Matthew Henry, and Keil & Delitzsch where available), and StudyLight.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu) for the Methodist view, Monergism and Ligonier for the Reformed view, Spurgeon for the Baptist view, and Lutheran sources. The likeliest verses are the restoration promises in vv. 6 and 39 and the "cup" in v. 12.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes (netbible.org) on things like Milcom/Malcam (vv. 1, 3), Ai in Ammon, Dedan, Hazor, and Elam. Then Catholic and Orthodox readings, and any popular modern teaching, only where those sites actually discuss this chapter.

Each point would come with its page URL, and I'd leave out anything I can't find.
